page.offset: 0..sourcebytes; returns <=4096bytes with full source identity and same annotations for both arms

query.field: same; complete source and unit matching then full declared unit closure; no hidden top-k

trace.source: sourceID; all same explicitly declared family versions, exact source difference enclosures, preserved labels and dependency-binding changes; no currentness choice

admission: No product code exists at freeze; initial oracle b93b... retained; revised per-scenario <=16 oracle23525546... retained before implementation. Public development only, no heldouts/models/humans/outreach/newinstallation/privilege/spending/service.

annotation_schema.sources: list of exact {id,revision,encoding,media_type,bytes,sha256,attributes}; attributes is bounded JSON data, includes declared family/version labels where supplied
annotation_schema.units: list of exact {id,source,span:[begin,end],sha256,whole_unit:true,dependencies:[unitID],annotations:object}; boundary is author-declared, not proved meaningful

core: comparison/retrieval/retrieval.py Corpus(sources:dict[str,bytes], annotations:bytes, expected_annotations_sha256:str); call(canonical_request_bytes)->canonical_response_bytes_with_LF; close(); metrics() separate from result identity.
fairness: Same sources and identical pinned annotations enter one core after independent original/transport verification. Adapters do not implement matching/closure. Index setup, queries, byte/context retrieval and changed-version tracing charged separately, cold/warm explicit. No artificial restriction of native-original comparator to this API; strongest retrieval still unqualified until prespecified comparison.
fts_bounds: No silent FTS token truncation: reject indexed text runs >32768 UTF8bytes between definite ASCII-whitespace separators for FTS mode only; literal modes retain full valid corpus. In-memory database <=8388608 bytes by page limit and checked size; fixed SQL, progress callback bounded work. Existing trusted C/Python/OS boundary, not formal proof.
graph: Index may preserve unresolved declarative annotation references as data. Successful expand requires every reachable dependency and acyclic selected closure; named missing/cycle refusal, no partial successful expansion. This is not a semantic package validator.

matching.all_tokens: ASCII-space-separated, nonempty tokens, each case-sensitive substring within same unit; <=32tokens. Independent raw oracle policy unchanged.
matching.exact_phrase: Case-sensitive contiguous original UTF8 bytes; annotation matching separately labeled. No normalization.
matching.fts5: Additional optional ranked SQLite FTS5 unicode61 remove_diacritics0 token-AND search. Query tokens quoted/parameterized; no supplied SQL/MATCH operators/extensions. Source bytes unchanged; normalization is matching-only, not semantic equality. BM25 ascending then stable source/unit/origin tie-break. No raw score truth claims. Explicit failure if optional backend unavailable or progress/token bound exceeded.

outputs: Fixed snapshot identity binds exact source/annotation identities. Return complete units and required context on query/expand; if complete response cannot fit bound, explicit refusal, no truncation. Raw source page is only its returned byte span. All responses authority NONE, freshness UNKNOWN, context adequacy UNPROVEN, data_is_untrusted true. Timings separate for exact arm equality.
scope: Shared bounded source-and-annotation retrieval; data only, not semantic interpretation or strongest-baseline qualification.
source_contract: All exact source IDs/lengths/SHA256 must match held annotation metadata; <=16 files and65536 aggregatebytes. UTF8 strictly decoded only where declared utf-8; opaque always byte-preserved, no inferred text extraction. Units anchor exact byte slices; no sentence splitting or Unicode normalization.
unknowns: No-match is UNKNOWN_NO_MATCH; exclusively opaque scope UNKNOWN_NON_TEXT. Unannotated full-source hits remain visible and preserve full-source fallback, no invented meaning unit. All data/annotation origins explicit.
